sections.subhead: Accept Payments Securely, Across Any Platform, Without Losing Sales at Checkout

body.text: Teknoppy integrates payment gateways in Kochi for WooCommerce, Shopify and custom stores - Razorpay, UPI and cards for India, plus Stripe and PayPal for international customers. We set up, test with real transactions and go live in 1-2 weeks, with card data handled by the gateway, not your server.

Payment gateway issues rarely appear in synthetic sandbox environments — they surface with real customers, real debit/credit cards, and actual bank servers. We configure bulletproof webhook listeners, auto-reconciliation, and multi-currency fallbacks so you never lose a sale at the checkout step.

items.title: India: Razorpay, Cashfree & UPI
items.html: Complete setup of Razorpay, Cashfree, PayU, and CCAvenue. Supports BHIM UPI (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm), net banking across 50+ Indian banks, credit/debit cards, EMI plans, and cash on delivery (COD) with OTP confirmation.

items.title: International: Stripe & PayPal
items.html: Enables global cross-border payments in USD, EUR, GBP, AED, and 135+ currencies with Stripe Elements, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and PayPal Express Checkout.

items.title: GCC & Middle East Gateways
items.html: Integration with regional Middle East processors including Telr, Tap Payments, PayTabs, and Network International for UAE, Qatar, and Saudi Arabia customers.

items.title: Custom API & Split Settlements
items.html: Node-level REST API and webhook integrations for marketplace split disbursements, automated vendor payouts, and recurring subscription billing. Explore our API Integration Services.

items.title: PCI-DSS Scope Reduction
items.text: We implement the gateway's secure hosted checkouts, embedded iframe modals, and tokenized APIs so raw customer card numbers never touch your application server, minimizing your PCI-DSS compliance burden.

items.title: 3-D Secure 2.0 & Two-Factor Authentication
items.text: Fully compliant with RBI regulations and international PSD2 mandates, routing transactions through frictionless biometric or OTP verification.

items.title: Cryptographic Webhook Signature Verification
items.text: Prevents spoofed payment confirmations by validating SHA-256 HMAC cryptographic signatures on every webhook event before updating order statuses.

items.title: Automated Failed-Payment Fallbacks
items.text: Smart retry logic and abandoned checkout triggers that automatically prompt customers with alternative payment channels (e.g., offering UPI if a credit card fails).

items.title: 2. Environment Setup & API Configuration (Days 3-5)

items.title: 4. Security & Webhook Validation (Days 9-10)

items.title: 5. Live Real-Money Transaction Testing (Days 11-12)

items.q: Which payment gateway is best for an online store in India?
items.a: Razorpay and Cashfree are currently the leading options for Indian ecommerce stores. They offer near-instant UPI intent flows, support 50+ net banking institutions, cards, EMI, and offer reliable webhook settlement speeds with competitive transaction rates (around 2% + GST).

The payment gateway charges a transaction fee (typically 1.5% to 3% + GST) deducted automatically from each customer payment. This fee is paid directly to the payment processor, not to Teknoppy. Our fee covers integration, checkout design, and testing.

items.q: What documents are required to activate a merchant payment gateway account?
items.a: Most Indian gateways require your company PAN card, GST registration certificate, business address proof, bank account cancelled cheque, and a live website with compliant privacy policy, terms of service, and refund/cancellation policy pages.

items.q: How does webhook verification prevent payment drops?
items.a: Webhooks allow the payment gateway's server to notify your website server directly when a payment succeeds, even if the customer accidentally closes their browser tab before redirecting back. Proper webhook handling guarantees the order is marked paid and inventory is allocated.

items.q: Can you set up payments in multiple currencies?
items.a: Yes. We configure multi-currency payment architectures using Stripe or PayPal alongside Indian domestic processors, allowing overseas customers to checkout in USD, EUR, GBP, or AED while settlements are converted to your home currency.

items.q: What happens if a payment integration breaks after launch?
items.a: We conduct extensive live-transaction testing to prevent launch errors. For ongoing peace of mind, we provide SLA support through our Website Maintenance Services or specialized WordPress Maintenance Services.
